purpose: Review city-local registry basis and anonymous geometry-only routes without querying personal/property attributes.
assessment: The official Imphal Municipality map is a planning reference image, not a public cadastral polygon contract. No anonymous full-polygon endpoint, safe field schema or citywide completeness was verified.
registryAssessment: The Government of Manipur Revenue Department describes the state land-record system, its village/urban-ward record units, and field maps, while the Government of Manipur publishes an Imphal Municipality cadastral map and explicitly directs users to the Directorate of Settlement & Land Record for the official office map. This supports local land-record administration; the published municipal map is planning-only and does not establish open parcel geometry or complete registry coverage at the WUP point.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Manipur Revenue Department land-record system describes field maps, Dag Chitha/Jamabandi records and settled village records.
The official preparation page describes records at village level and, in towns, more or less at ward level.
Government of Manipur Imphal Municipality cadastral PDF is explicitly marked for planning only and says office cadastral maps should be obtained from the Directorate of Settlement & Land Record.
The official Land Resources Department about page places the department in Imphal and describes GIS/survey/record responsibilities; it does not publish city parcel vectors.
